program.section_heading: Edible Education Garden Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to select garden plant varieties for different growing conditions, including traditional gardens, landscapes and hydroponic methods.
Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to design and plan edible gardens, landscapes suitable for the San Joaquin Valley.
Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to evaluate environmental and plant health conditions to determine proper care methods for edible plants.
Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to evaluate tree and plant health requirements and explain placement, planting and maintenance methods to achieve the best outcome.

blocks.name: Core Courses-54 hours (Credits listed are in hours)
